node.title: L1: mixed-petal / diffuse partial-petal amplification is polynomially bounded (large-defect regime)
node.statement: At every official row and for every received word U, the mixed-petal or diffuse partial-petal contributors to #ImgFib_U(k+sigma) are polynomially bounded above the corrected reserve, with quotient profiles budgeted. The exact-shell prefix/Hankel bridge gives two honest closure routes: global received-word Toeplitz prefix flatness, or aggregate local first-owner payment in one fixed source. Fixed-cofactor transport writes shell a with forced e=deg(U)-a as at most q^e depth-(a-k+e) locator-prefix fibers, with e=0 exactly one upstream locator-Q atom. Cofactor-depth budget cancellation proves that for e<k this q^e factor cancels under ambient normalization, while image normalization retains q^(a-k+e)/L_(a,a-k+e) and integer rounding loses less than q^e. The cofactor-prefix Pade normal form makes the below-cap targets one graph, and the full-locator Pade section extends the exact split-divisor intersection to every e via the a-k equations [T^(e+1..e+a-k)]Uhat/Lhat=0. The Pade-remainder Jacobian theorem gives differential D -> -(QD mod L): on gcd(L,Q)=1 the section is smooth of local codimension a-k, and every rank failure lies on the tangent resultant. Exact shells therefore split into primitive transverse gcd(Q,Omega)=1 and tangent gcd(L,Q)!=1 classes. Thus the live global task is a tangent first-match payment plus row-sharp split-point concentration on a smooth primitive full-locator Pade section, with depth-uniform Q as its top-prefix edge and decorated support-pair control as its second moment. Canonical cofactor gcd descent removes q^(2e) decoration counting through e<=w+2c; an exact F_13 endpoint family proves the reduced high branch must retain its received-word owner. On the local route, maximal-source domination removes source-layout multiplicity; the anchor census removes whole-petal-anchored quotient-polynomial supply; the tame fixed-petal refinement census reduces all tame refinement maps to at most M tau(ell)<=n classes; the periodic-owner obstruction proves those maps do not automatically have multiplicatively periodic exact supports; and the anchored triple-polarity closure pays partial source cores plus every numerator/Forney fiber at fixed layout, core-defect, and petal polarity. The raw-ledger fence proves independent support summation exponentially loose. The unpaid local mechanisms are small-scale general-pullback or collective aperiodic-support payment on known tame refinements, wild or unanchored quotient maps, growing signed layout/core-defect/petal polarity, the balanced sub-Johnson strip, and arbitrary petal locators outside one common pencil. Thus closure requires either the global smooth-section/tangent payment or aggregate payment of this narrower internal residual. At the first characteristic checkpoint, all five official next-to-maximal order-zero HNF endpoint chambers are now closed by the m=8 and m=16 reciprocal eliminations; order one, lower value degrees, nonembedded m=4,h=2, and inner lifts remain. FALSIFIER: a reserve-valid word family whose mixed-petal image-fiber count exceeds every polynomial, or a route-kill lower bound. KNOWN MASS: 43 mixed-petal floor-band contributors versus 10 full-petal at (16,8,97).
